lines.say: My regular stopped coming in. So I landed a helicopter at his wedding.
caps: So I landed a helicopter at his wedding.

lines.say: The bride screamed. The band stopped. I climbed out in my apron, holding clippers, and yelled, nobody move!
caps: The bride screamed. The band stopped.

lines.say: His uncle tackled me. Straight into the cake. Four layers. Gone.
caps: Straight into the cake. Four layers. Gone.

lines.say: Comment KEEP if a client has ever just disappeared on you.

lines.say: Then three cop cars showed up. The officer asked why I did it. I said, he missed two fades, officer.
caps: Then three cop cars showed up.
I said, *he missed two fades,* officer.

lines.say: And the groom walks up. In a tux. Crying. He goes, bro. I was busy getting married. You could've just texted me.
caps: The groom walks up. In a tux. Crying.
He goes, bro. I was busy getting married.

lines.say: That's the whole reason. Nobody texted him. Now I'm banned from every venue in Atlanta.
So now I use Message Health. It spots who's gone quiet, and texts them before they forget.

lines.say: No helicopter. No cake. No cops. Just a text.
